Listed words still demanding in context but not carrying a question alone: loonstrook, identiteitskaart, monteur, mededeling, tijdelijk, rolstoelen, inleveren.

checks.official_sources: Item 6: rijksoverheid.nl "Hoe kan ik mijn huis ventileren" opened 22 November 2026: grilles and vents open day and night; extra ventilation after cooking, showering, painting; "Alleen luchten ... is niet genoeg". The script now says to keep the grilles open; the ten-minute, twice-a-day airing is consistent with RIVM and landlord advice (10 to 15 minutes; not stated on the Rijksoverheid page), and laundry and wiping black spots are common landlord advice not on that page. Item 8: connexxion.nl "OVpay: checking in and out with your debit card" (always check in and out with the same card; the same system for all operators) and ns.nl "Inchecken of uitchecken vergeten" (a standard amount is charged; no figure on the page) opened 22 November 2026. The item is framed as one company's own rule ("bij Streekbus Holtrijk", "bij ons"); the 2.50 and 5 euro figures are invented and not the national forgotten-check-out amount. Item 1: no national rule; amounts invented.

limitations: AI editorial review does not validate CEFR difficulty or official exam equivalence.

meaning.situation_summary: Selin has a letter that her monthly energy payment goes up and phones the energy company: she learns old and new amount, the reason, that the meter readings can lower it from April, and that she must enter them in the app.
meaning.communicative_purpose: Find out whether the increase is right, whether it can be lowered, and how to give the meter readings; the call ends with her plan to do it today.
meaning.contrivance_check: The employee gives a reason (more gas in the cold months) and Selin answers it with a reason of her own (she kept the heating low); the lower amount depends on meter numbers, which is how a real advance payment is corrected; nothing off-page is needed.
